description: Department: Marketing & Communications Location: Berlin Description The Growth Marketing Manager owns growth for osapiens' CMMS software – a product line for automating a company's maintenance operations, built and run with the speed and instincts of a founder driving a new product to market. The job spans building out CMMS's market presence (website, digital ads, value proposition) and pushing revenue hard from day one, across a GTM motion that blends self-serve/PLG with Sales-led demand capture, the majority of which flows to Sales – both need attention, neither at the other's expense. This is a genuine growth role: relentlessly data-driven, but with the creative instinct to spot and chase opportunities a pure numbers read would miss. Agencies support execution on performance channels and the website, and this person directs that work – but the real job is finding what actually moves revenue and going after it fast, in an environment where the playbook is still being written. What You’ll Own Growth strategy Own the growth strategy across both self-serve/PLG and Sales-led demand capture Set the channel mix to hit the CMMS-specific growth targets, revisited as the product and market evolve Bring hunger to the role: chase revenue like it's a founder's own product, using AI to move at a high pace Market presence & positioning Build and own CMMS's market presence – website, digital ads, LinkedIn page, positioning, and everything else this product line needs to show up strongly, not just a set of digital assets Define CMMS-specific positioning and messaging for its buyers (maintenance managers, operations leads, facility directors), in partnership with Product and Sales Digital Campaign Management & Demand Capture Own digital campaign execution across paid, SEO/GEO, and CMMS's other core channels – hands-on where it matters, working through agencies where it multiplies reach; using AI to handle the volume work a full team would otherwise do Build the path from first interest to a qualified Sales handoff, and design the equivalent journey for self-serve users – trial, activation, and expansion Direct the digital performance agency and website agency, briefing and holding them accountable to CMMS's goals – execution partners, not a substitute for this person's own hands-on involvement Stakeholder alignment & reporting Get every stakeholder – Product, Sales, agencies, Marketing Operations – genuinely bought in and contributing to CMMS's growth, not just informed of it Build and own CMMS's reporting from the ground up, AI-assisted – pipeline, revenue, trial sign-ups and activation, cost per MQL/SQL, channel ROI – not inheriting someone else's dashboard Report CMMS growth and revenue performance with commercially-framed recommendations This role covers a full product's marketing ownership, and that only works with the help of AI doing what a small team normally would What You’ll Bring Background 5-8+ years in digital, performance, or growth marketing, ideally with a track record in a fast-growing SaaS business Hands-on experience building or scaling a PLG motion – free trials, freemium, in-product activation – not just familiarity with the concept Experience building demand capture for a Sales-led motion Deep, practical channel expertise across paid, SEO/GEO, and digital campaigns Experience directing agencies or external partners, not only executing personally Genuine AI fluency in a marketing execution context – using AI daily to cover ground a small team would otherwise need Experience in CMMS, industrial SaaS, maintenance management, or adjacent verticals (facilities, operations, asset management) is a strong plus Fluent English required; German is a plus How you work Owns outcomes like a founder would – genuinely hungry to grow CMMS's revenue, not just execute a marketing plan Equally comfortable being hands-on and directing others – runs campaigns personally and holds agencies accountable, as the moment requires Combines rigor with instinct: reads the data, but also spots and chases opportunities the data alone wouldn't surface Thrives without a fixed playbook – builds the approach as CMMS's market presence takes shape, rather than needing one handed to them Proactively brings Product, Sales, and agency partners along, rather than working in a silo and reporting out after the fact What Success Looks Like First 3 months CMMS's website, ads, and LinkedIn presence are live, positioning is defined, and the SEA/SEO/PLG funnel has been audited with a clear action plan The core structure for both funnels – self-serve and Sales-led – is set up and running First paid campaigns are live with baseline KPIs established, and signal-based workflows are feeding Sales outreach directly Reporting infrastructure exists from day one, even if still maturing By year one CMMS has a strong, established market presence within osapiens' portfolio – its digital presence no longer reads as an afterthought Both self-serve and Sales-led pipeline are measurably growing CMMS's search presence (SEA, SEO, GEO) is strong and compounding across target markets, and funnel conversion is consistently improving Leadership can see exactly what's driving CMMS's revenue, and the Growth Marketer can clearly account for it Join us for this and more... A purpose-driven mission where you tackle complex sustainability challenges alongside global industry pioneers. Room for creativity through collaborative teamwork and an open communication culture. Flexibility and team bonding with our hybrid work options. Fuel for your growth journey, both personally and professionally. Sustainable mobility options, promoting eco-friendly commuting solutions. Fun team events and outings with our global teams.

description: Hoe zorg je ervoor dat een goed idee van een klant uiteindelijk ook echt een goed werkende IT-oplossing wordt? Als Business Analyst ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen de business, de klant en development. Je duikt in processen, stelt de juiste vragen, brengt requirements boven tafel en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke user stories waar ontwikkelteams mee aan de slag kunnen. Bedrijfsomschrijving Omschrijving Je werkt aan uiteenlopende maatwerkoplossingen voor onze opdrachtgevers met vaak complexe en unieke vraagstukken. Van grote industriële organisaties tot publieke en internationale instellingen. Geen standaardoplossingen dus, maar projecten waar je echt meerwaarde kan leveren. Wat ga je doen? Als Business Analyst ben je vanaf de start van een traject nauw betrokken bij de klant. Je onderzoekt hoe processen momenteel verlopen, waar knelpunten zitten en wat er nodig is om deze met een IT-oplossing te ondersteunen. Je bent niet alleen betrokken bij het begin van een project. Ook tijdens de ontwikkeling blijf je de verbinding tussen klant en team bewaken. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: In kaart brengen en analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen bij klanten. Ophalen, analyseren en structureren van requirements. Doorvragen naar de achterliggende behoefte en onderscheid maken tussen hoofd- en bijzaken. Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete user stories en requirements. Opbouwen en onderhouden van een backlog, bijvoorbeeld in Azure DevOps. Samenwerken met Product Owners en hen waar nodig ondersteunen. De vertaalslag maken van businessvraagstukken naar ontwikkelteams. Developers voorzien van voldoende context en informatie om de juiste oplossing te bouwen. Tijdens de ontwikkelfase betrokken blijven bij vragen, wijzigingen en verdere uitwerking. Vastleggen van relevante documentatie en projectinformatie. Meedenken in pre-sales en het herkennen van nieuwe kansen bij bestaande klanten. Je nieuwe team Als Business Analist maak je deel uit van een multidisciplinair team van Developers, Solution Architects en Microsoft-specialisten. Samen realiseer je slimme maatwerkoplossingen die direct bijdragen aan de doelstellingen van onze opdrachtgevers. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van inhoudelijke diepgang, afwisseling en ontwikkeling. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten, krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid en hebt directe invloed op de oplossingen die worden ontworpen en gerealiseerd. Tegelijkertijd kun je rekenen op een team waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en vakmanschap centraal staan. Kortom: een omgeving waarin je wordt uitgedaagd en zichtbare impact maakt! description: About The Role - We are looking for a Product Owner to own the product roadmap and backlog for the UniqPay platform: acquiring, payouts, currency conversion, and risk. You decide what gets built, in what order, and why. You are the voice of the merchant, the acquirer, and the regulator inside our engineering process, and the single owner of scope and acceptance for every sprint. As Product Owner you sit between Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and Sales. You turn merchant demand, partner constraints, and regulatory obligations into a single prioritised roadmap, write the specifications that engineers build from, and carry what you learn at launch back into the next release. Because our merchants are in regulated industries operating across many countries, prior hands-on product experience in these verticals across international markets is mandatory, not preferred. What You Will Do - Own the roadmap: Maintain the product roadmap for acquiring, payouts, FX, and risk, balancing merchant demand, commercial priority, technical debt, and regulatory obligation. Run the backlog: Write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria that cover payment edge cases: declines, retries, cascading, chargebacks, partial settlements, and FX. Ship every sprint: Lead sprint planning, refinement, and review; act as the single decision maker on scope and acceptance; track delivery and make trade offs early. Design for the regulator: Turn licensing conditions, KYC and KYB rules, AML monitoring, data residency, and scheme requirements into product requirements for each jurisdiction, and re-scope the backlog when the rules change. Know the verticals: Run structured discovery with regulated merchants and with acquiring and banking partners, and build market by market knowledge of local payment methods and settlement rails. Own the integrations: Lead the product side of PSP, acquirer, and merchant integrations: API specifications, timelines, and channel configuration. Measure what matters: Define and track approval rates, latency, settlement accuracy, onboarding time to live, and merchant retention, and use them to steer prioritisation. Close the loop: Run launch readiness and post launch and post incident reviews, and convert every lesson into a backlog item or a process change. Who You Are - Experience: 4 to 6 years in product ownership or product management, including at least 2 years shipping payments or fintech products for iGaming, Crypto, or FX merchants across international markets. This is a hard requirement. Vertical knowledge: You understand how these merchants make money and lose it: cascading and approval rates, on and off ramp flows and settlement and margin dynamics in specific regulated industries. Regulatory fluency: Direct experience applying licensing, KYC and KYB, AML, data residency, and card scheme rules in product design across more than one jurisdiction. Delivery discipline: Hands on ownership of an agile backlog: writing stories, running ceremonies, and being accountable for sprint outcomes. Technical depth: Comfortable working with engineers on API driven products and third party integrations, and able to read a sequence diagram or an API log without help. Judgement: You say no clearly and often, and can explain a prioritisation call to a founder, a compliance officer, and an engineer in the same meeting. Education: A bachelor degree in Business, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field preferred. CSPO, PSPO, or equivalent is a plus. Bonus points if - You have sat across the table from a regulator, an auditor, or a card scheme during a licence application, audit, or review. You have launched a product into a new country or corridor and dealt with the local payment methods and rules that came with it. You have built the product function at an early stage company where the process did not exist yet. Where this role goes - The Product Owner seat is the proving ground for the Product Manager role. Show that you can run the roadmap, keep the platform compliant across markets, and think a level up, and the path to leading the wider product function is direct. What Is Next - We aim to reply to every application within three business days, and our interview process usually takes around three to four weeks. It is a short, practical process: a real conversation, an exercise that looks like the actual job rather than a brain teaser, and time with the people you would work beside, founders included. Tell us if you need more flexibility at any stage. Our Take On Who Belongs Here - Our team has a vision that spans several nationalities, time zones, and payment traditions, and we think that is exactly why we will make good calls in cross border payments. Whoever you are and wherever you are from, you are welcome to be yourself here.

description: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead. At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors. Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities. The Role Veeva’s OpenData team is expanding the Product rapidly across Asia. We are looking for an entrepreneurial, energetic Product Manager who can lead OpenData in Southeast Asia. The vision of OpenData is to help the life sciences industry better connect with the healthcare ecosystems in order to improve care. The Product provides comprehensive reference and profile information on key aspects of healthcare, together with the insights needed by the industry. As the Product Manager for Southeast Asia, you will build and deploy the Product in key markets. You will be responsible for the Product Strategy and Feature Roadmap of OpenData and be passionate about product excellence and customer success. You will need to apply your intuition and experience to make good decisions around the product direction and strategy in your markets. You will also play a critical role, working together with the OpenData leadership, to define the right go-to-market approach. This role will require an ability to creatively problem solve, build strategic relationships in the market and lead. You coach and direct the product development team on building a quality Product. You will work together with our commercial teams to decide on the appropriate marketing activities for the Product. You will execute good analytics to support the success of customers using our Product. This role will be based in Singapore. What You’ll Do Research and understand the customer and their needs. Own the User Journey. Stay abreast of market developments and identify new needs / opportunities for the Product. Develop short- and long-term product roadmaps and country strategies. Creatively identify new data sources and partnerships that could strengthen the Product. Direct the product development team to execute the product roadmap and product quality agenda. Drive quality and excellence in our Product, processes, and database. Engage internal and external customers to demonstrate the value of the Product. Ensure the success of customers using the Product. Actively contribute to the success of the commercial pipeline Requirements 3+ years in product management, consulting, or related fields Agile Project Management (Scrum) Analytical skills Database knowledge High attention to detail and passion for quality Commercially astute Local Health Care market understanding People management & development Excellent presentation skills Entrepreneurial, autonomous, and proactive Ability to work under pressure Teamwork Fluent in English Nice to Have Management Consulting experience Experience with master data management concepts and applications Familiarity with Marketing Experience with visualization tools for analytics or business intelligence Pharma company SFE/Marketing/IT working experience Working experience with databases/data product such as SQL, PostgreSQL Exposure to Salesforce CRM Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About Connect While accepting payments on the internet has become easier over the past several years, due in large part to the advent of modern payments APIs, the internet infrastructure for routing these same payments—to suppliers, sellers, partners, service providers, and recipients—remains outdated. Connect is Stripe’s leading product for marketplaces, on-demand services, ecommerce site builders, invoicing platforms, professional SaaS products, fundraising platforms, rental management platforms, and more. By using Connect, users in each of these categories can link multiple parties to exchange goods or services. These users rely on Connect for the crucial function of routing payments reliably between these parties. By powering fast, flexible, compliant, and cost-efficient payment routing on the internet, Connect not only spurs the creation of innovative business models but also enables organizations—whether businesses, nonprofits, or government agencies—to bring previously offline payments online. Why this role This is a chance to define a foundational product area at Stripe. You will turn a fast-changing set of user and product needs into durable platform primitives that work across products, industries, and geographies. The role combines high-leverage strategy with hands-on product execution. You will work through ambiguous, consequential questions like: what should a platform be able to model? What should be simple by default but flexible when needed? How can Stripe make complex financial infrastructure feel effortless for a platform and its users? The outcome of your work will compound. The abstractions you help create will be reused across Connect and Stripe, shaping what new products platforms can build and how quickly they can bring them to market. What you’ll do As a Product Manager on Stripe’s Connect team, you will shape the strategy and oversee the execution of high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms. Product development at Stripe is highly collaborative. You will work closely with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams. You will also engage directly with customers and present your plans to Stripe’s leadership team. Responsibilities Develop and advance a compelling product vision for Connect Devise the strategy for high-impact initiatives serving modern marketplaces and software platforms Translate product strategy and customer needs into clear product requirements Oversee execution across the teams involved in delivering these initiatives Collaborate with engineering, design, analytics, marketing, sales, and customer-facing teams Meet with customers to understand their needs and gather feedback Present product plans to Stripe’s leadership team and incorporate feedback Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements More than three years of product management experience A computer science background or equivalent experience Strong product judgment The ability to lead products that require coordination across multiple teams Strong written and verbal communication skills Persistence and resourcefulness in driving successful outcomes for products and teams Hybrid work at Stripe This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office). In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams. Working remotely at Stripe A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live. Pay and benefits The annual US base salary range for this role is $214,300 - $321,500. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our California applicant personal information notice here. The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

description: About Harry’s Harry’s is a men’s grooming brand that offers high quality shave, body, hair, and skin care products at an exceptional value. Launched in 2013, Harry’s redefined the shaving experience and helped pioneer the earliest era of direct to consumer in the process. Since then, the brand has become the #2 shave brand globally and expanded to offer products for every step in its customer’s routine. Harry’s is also on a mission to ensure guys have access to quality mental health care. To date, the brand has helped connect over 2 million men to quality mental health resources. Harry’s is part of Mammoth Brands, the modern CPG company behind category-leading brands Harry’s, Flamingo, Lume, Mando, and Coterie. Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo. Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community. Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date. We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible. We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it. About The Role We’re looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to lead and scale growth marketing efforts for Harry’s Intl (UK & DE). In this highly data-driven role you’ll be responsible for the strategy, execution, and optimization of performance marketing campaigns—overseeing key channels such as Meta, Google, Display, and Affiliates. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creative problem solving, rigorous analytics, and hands-on execution. You will run programs that directly impact our omni-channel growth, with a focus on driving efficient new customer acquisition and improving customer lifetime value (LTV). Responsibilities: Support delivery of profitable new customer acquisition, and help to define the longer term growth strategy across all channels. Partner with Product to deliver growth initiatives that ladder to commercial business goals Translate data (channel, cohort, NPS) into actionable insights and strategy. Own landing page roadmap and experimentation plan. Develop the growth analytics infrastructure, inc weekly & monthly reporting process to improve KPI visibility and decision-making. Surface insights to inform creative strategy and messaging. Identify growth opportunities across the funnel (LP, Welcome Emails, UX & new marketing channels) Drive operational excellence to ensure data accuracy and resolve tracking / pipeline issues Support on forecasting, spend allocation, and enable rapid performance pivots Drive adoption of AI and automation to improve team efficiency This might describe you: The ideal candidate wants to use their performance marketing experience alongside their strategic and analytical skills to help build a customer-centric, growth-minded organization Proven track record of success (2-3+ years) in performance marketing DTC, management consulting, strategy & operations, technology, or a similar background Intensely data-driven in your approach to solving problems, with a persistent desire to look for opportunities through data analysis, go multiple levels deep, understand, and take action. Motivated by learning and mastering new things; constantly testing & learning to figure things out; willing to take calculated risks. Experience working with omni-channel attribution models & global organisations would be preferential. Who you will work with: Report to Head of Growth Work side-by-side with a best-in-class Growth team - Performance Marketing, Creative, Insights and Brand team Internal Global teams at Harry’s including Digital Product, Lifecycle & Engagement, and Analytics Manage external vendors and agency partners across various marketing channels and tools Benefits And Perks Private medical and comprehensive dental coverage Pension savings plan with company match Group Income Protection and Life Assurance benefits Equity in Mammoth Brands Generous time off plus 8 paid bank holidays Wellness and L&D stipends 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years 20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop Free products from our family of brands Mammoth Brands is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do great work together. Mammoth Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer, providing equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals. We recruit, hire and promote into all job levels the most qualified applicants without regard to race, color, creed, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), parental status, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, transgender status, sexual orientation, marital, family or partnership status, political affiliation or activities, military service, domestic violence victim status, arrest/conviction record, sexual or reproductive health decisions, caregiver status, credit history immigration status, unemployment status, traits historically associated with race, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles or any other status protected under applicable federal, state and local laws. Mammoth Brands' commitment to providing equal employment opportunities extends to all aspects of employment, including job assignment, compensation, discipline and access to benefits and training. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our company. If visa sponsorship is required for work authorization, please note that Mammoth Brands in collaboration with immigration counsel will manage and submit all necessary legal filings on behalf of the candidate.

description: INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories. Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally. Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040. What You'll Be Doing The eCommerce Manager is responsible for driving the eCommerce strategy, managing the online P&L, and optimizing profitable growth. This role involves leveraging data insights, performance marketing, operations and online merchandising strategies to deliver a world-class customer experience while collaborating with internal teams, suppliers, and third-party agencies. Key Responsibilities Strategy & Planning eCommerce Strategy: Lead the annual strategy and budget in collaboration with the eCommerce General Manager and Brand General Manager. Trading Strategy: Manage product, pricing, and promotional strategies to drive site performance and build synergies across all channels (Retail, eCommerce, e-Retail, ..) P&L Management: Own the online brand P&L and leverage its insights to optimize cost drivers and improve profitability. Relationship Management: Cultivate internal and external relationships, including third-party agencies and e-Retail teams to drive eCommerce growth Online Merchandising Merchandising Strategy: Develop and execute a compelling product assortment and presentation strategy based on customer preferences, inventory , performances and trends. Site Optimization: Oversee product categorization, tagging, and search functionality for improved user experience and conversions. Promotions & Content: Plan and execute promotions, campaigns, and update product content to reflect accurate pricing, images, and descriptions. Performance Marketing & Web Analytics Marketing Campaigns: Develop and execute performance marketing strategies across digital channels (PPC, Display, Social, Affiliate) to drive traffic and conversions. Optimization: Continuously optimize marketing spend, creative, and targeting based on performance data. Analytics & Reporting: Use web data to identify areas for improvement, understand customer behavior onsite, optimize marketing performance and manage KPIs via eCommerce dashboards. Product Management Product Strategy: Develop product strategies that align with customer needs and brand objectives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to ensure products deliver an exceptional customer experience. Cross-Functional Leadership & Development Omnichannel Initiatives: Lead innovation in omnichannel experiences and work with central teams product team and Retail teams Prioritization & Roadmap: Manage the product roadmap and ensure alignment with business goals. What We Can Offer You With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day. We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts. Using GenAI in Your Application Process To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations. We Invite All Applicants to Apply It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity. We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

description: London/Hybrid £40,000 - £60,000 + share options up to £14,500 + Benefits 💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book, which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. The team We have a massive vision and even more ideas, but right now, our ambitions are outstripping our capacity. That’s where you come in. We aren't looking for someone to just "run the reports" we’re looking for a foundational member of a growing function who is excited to help us redefine how data influences product. At Accurx, we don't just wait for a roadmap to be handed down; we expect everyone to help shape it. While you'll be part of a team of expert data and product leaders, you'll be the one in the driver's seat for your domain. You won't be watching from the sidelines - you'll be proactively hunting for insights, challenging our current assumptions, and taking ownership of how data can save clinician time from day one. This is a role for a critical thinker who is energised by the "blank canvas" of a growing function and has the drive to turn raw data into a better reality for millions of patients. Challenges you’ll solve... You will steer product strategy by partnering with Product Managers to define what success looks like and by monitoring the KPIs that prove our impact on the frontline of healthcare. You will interrogate user behaviour by performing deep-dive analyses that look past the surface to find the "why," ensuring we’re solving the right problems for the right people. You will lead rigorous experiments by helping design and run A/B tests, owning the process from the initial hypothesis through to the final, data-backed recommendation. You will build the engine for self-service insights by creating the dashboards and visualisations that ensure your pod has high-quality data at their fingertips to move fast. You should apply if... You've worked within a product team environment (not just as a standalone data or BI function), partnering directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and Designers on live product decisions, not just reporting on outcomes after the fact. You are a proactive investigator who doesn't need a ticket to start digging; when things are quiet, you’re already looking for the next trend or bottleneck that we’ve missed. You have a "get stuck in" mindset - you’re excited by a lean environment where you can build your own processes and take on challenges that push you outside your comfort zone. You bring strong Product Thinking with an understanding of user funnels and a hunger to master metrics like activation, retention, and cohort behaviour. You are sharpening a strong technical toolkit, with a solid command of SQL and the ambition to use Python. You are a delivery-focused collaborator who thrives in agile environments and knows how to communicate technical findings clearly to engineers and designers. You’ve used tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude and are ready to become a power user who empowers the whole team through effective data storytelling. What’s in it for me? You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to Fix Healthcare Communication £40,000 - £60,000 salary + share options up to £14,500 Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year Family matters: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support We have our very own Chef! Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches will be provided, with the occasional sweet treat!

description: Purpose The Product Owner (Supply Chain & Logistics) is a key member of the Service Platforms Team at Post Office Ltd (POL), responsible for owning, developing and continuously improving the Supply Chain & Logistics product portfolio. The role is accountable for ensuring that product investments deliver measurable value to the business while supporting POL's operational and strategic objectives for 2026 and beyond. The Product Owner will lead day-to-day product management activities across the Supply Chain & Logistics domain, including defining and maintaining the product vision, roadmap and prioritised backlog. Working closely with business stakeholders, operational teams, technology partners and software delivery squads, the role will translate business requirements into clearly defined epics, features and user stories, supported by robust acceptance criteria, success measures and business outcomes. The role is responsible for ensuring that product development activity is aligned to agreed priorities, balancing new capabilities, operational improvements, technical debt reduction and regulatory or business requirements. Through active ownership of Agile product management practices and ceremonies, the Product Owner will provide clear direction to delivery teams, remove ambiguity, manage dependencies and ensure the successful delivery and adoption of new functionality. Acting as the primary link between Supply Chain & Logistics stakeholders and technology delivery teams, the Product Owner will build strong relationships across the organisation, ensuring requirements are understood, priorities are aligned and risks, issues and opportunities are identified and managed proactively. The role will work closely with the Head of Service Platforms and wider transformation teams to support the successful delivery of strategic change initiatives. The Product Owner will define and manage the Supply Chain & Logistics roadmap for 2026-27 and beyond, ensuring that the product portfolio evolves to meet changing business needs while delivering an improved experience for customers, operational users and delivery partners. As a member of the wider Product Management community, the role will champion product best practices, foster a culture of continuous improvement and contribute to the ongoing maturity of product delivery across Post Office. Throughout all activities, the Product Owner will consistently demonstrate Post Office values and behaviours, maintaining a customer-first mindset and a strong focus on delivering sustainable business outcomes. Principle Accountabilities Core Accountabilities include: Lead the Supply Chain & Logistics product portfolio, defining and delivering the roadmap to support POL’s strategic and operational objectives. Own and prioritise the product backlog, translating business needs into clear epics, features and user stories with measurable outcomes. Lead product initiatives from discovery through to deployment, ensuring delivery meets agreed timelines, quality standards and governance requirements. Collaborate with business stakeholders, operational teams, suppliers and delivery squads to align priorities, manage dependencies and maximise business value. Use customer, Postmaster and colleague feedback, alongside data and insights, to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Balance new capability delivery with operational requirements, technical debt reduction, risk management and compliance obligations. Monitor product performance, benefits realisation and return on investment (ROI), making evidence-based decisions to optimise outcomes (product and strategic level). Champion Post Office values and behaviours, fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusion, innovation and continuous improvement. Job Specific Accountabilities Include Leading an initiative that is a key element of POL’s strategic Annual Business Plan, this role will: Maintain a high-quality product backlog containing well-defined Epics, Features and User Stories with clear acceptance criteria. Partner with business product and process owners to understand requirements, priorities and desired outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer within the Supply Chain & Logistics domain. Own and prioritise the product roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with longer-term strategic planning. Communicate the product vision, roadmap and priorities to stakeholders through regular team events and governance forums. Drive product adoption and proactively identify and remove barriers to success. Measure and track product value against agreed business objectives. Manage and prioritise development activity through tools such as Jira, Confluence and Aha!, ensuring backlog items are refinement-ready and prioritised. Manage technical debt across products and services, ensuring it is addressed alongside roadmap commitments. Coach, mentor and develop product management capability across the wider Technology function. Ensure Supply Chain & Logistics roadmaps align with broader business strategy and priorities. Translate requirements into clear user stories and epics aligned to strategic initiatives. Engage and communicate regularly with business stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. Ensure stories are clearly defined, accurately documented and supported by robust acceptance criteria. description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers. We are looking for a Platform Product Manager to join our Payward Services team. This is a builder: someone who can own a product roadmap end to end, go deep on how a flow actually works, and ship regulated B2B2C products (KYC/KYB, lending, unified APIs) from concept to launch. The opportunity Own the product roadmap and build-out for our B2B2C platform products (KYC/KYB, lending, unified APIs) Defining requirements, partnering with Engineering on execution, and driving products from concept through launch and iteration. Get hands-on with the product itself: how a flow works, where it breaks, what needs to change to make it scale, and what it takes to bring it to market in a regulated environment. Drive cross-functional execution with Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to turn roadmap priorities into shipped product. Partner with Legal and Compliance to ensure new product builds meet regulatory requirements as part of the design and build process, rather than as a downstream gate. At a high level, support the operational functions tied to our US regulated entities as needed to keep product work moving. What You Bring Strong product management experience: you've owned a roadmap, shipped B2B or B2B2C products, and can speak fluently to product strategy, requirements, and execution. Direct, hands on experience implementing KYC, either building it in house or standing up a KYC solution to resell or offer to external parties. This is a must have, not a nice to have. Experience building or managing platform products (shared infrastructure, APIs, internal client or partner models) in a B2B or B2B2C context. Experience building products in a regulated environment, at a financial institution, fintech, or similar, with a solid understanding of how regulation shapes product decisions. description: Designation: DTC Growth and Performance Analyst Location: Dubai, UAE About SUMWON STUDIOS SUMWON STUDIOS is a global brand house building, scaling and reimagining culturally relevant fashion, lifestyle and consumer brands. Our portfolio includes MISSGUIDED, SUMWON, BALR, Baby Phat, Playboy, AiiRZ, KiZN and KSTM. In just a few years, we have grown from start-up to one of the fastest-scaling brand platforms in the industry. Combining creativity, data, technology and an agile supply chain, we build brands designed to win in today's digital-first world. We operate at the intersection of culture, commerce and innovation. Whether launching new brands, acquiring established ones, or unlocking growth opportunities across our portfolio, we move quickly, think globally and challenge conventional ways of working. The Role We are looking for an AI-first, commercially minded and highly analytical DTC Growth & Performance Analyst to become the intelligence engine behind our DTC and webshop businesses. This role sits across the full commercial funnel, connecting marketing acquisition, onsite experience, merchandising, pricing and customer behaviour to identify opportunities to accelerate profitable growth through data, experimentation and AI. Rather than owning a single function, you will connect analytics across Marketing, CRM, Digital Trade, Pricing and Finance to understand what is driving performance, where customers are dropping off and which initiatives have the greatest potential commercial impact. You will use modern AI tools alongside analytics platforms to automate analysis, uncover insights, accelerate decision-making and build scalable reporting. Success in this role comes from asking the right commercial questions, finding answers quickly and translating those insights into measurable business outcomes. You will work closely with leaders across Digital Trade, Marketing, Pricing and Finance, helping improve key commercial KPIs including traffic quality, conversion, AOV, profitability, customer cohorts, LTV and retention. Key Responsibilities End-to-End Commercial Performance & Analytics Analyse performance across the complete customer journey, from marketing acquisition through to conversion and repeat purchase. Connect marketing performance, onsite behaviour, pricing, merchandising and operational data to build clear commercial narratives. Identify high-impact growth opportunities through quantitative analysis and data-led decision-making. Monitor funnel performance across acquisition, engagement, product discovery, checkout and repeat purchase. Produce clear, actionable recommendations to improve traffic quality, conversion, AOV, profitability and customer lifetime value. Partner with Marketing to evaluate channel quality, campaign effectiveness, CAC, ROAS and incrementality. Partner with Digital Trade and Merchandising to optimise product visibility, assortment, navigation and customer journeys. Partner with Pricing to identify opportunities around price elasticity, promotional effectiveness and margin. Use data to prioritise experiments, initiatives and feature improvements based on potential commercial impact. Translate complex datasets and analysis into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. AI-Driven Analytics & Automation Use AI tools to automate repetitive analysis, reporting and data processes. Build AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual work and accelerate insight generation. Leverage LLMs and AI analytics platforms to identify trends, anomalies and commercial opportunities. Develop effective prompts, automations and AI-powered workflows that improve decision-making speed. Evaluate and introduce new AI tools that can improve productivity across Digital Trade, Marketing and the wider commercial organisation. Use AI to generate hypotheses, identify opportunities and surface customer insights from both structured and unstructured data. Continuously explore new AI-enabled approaches to improve how the commercial organisation works with data. Champion an AI-first approach to analytics, experimentation and decision-making. Commercial Experimentation & Optimisation Design and evaluate experiments across marketing, pricing, merchandising, promotions, customer journeys and onsite experience. Define clear objectives and success metrics before experiments are launched. Analyse results and assess the statistical and commercial impact of initiatives. Make data-led recommendations on whether initiatives should be scaled, adapted or stopped. Maintain a central experimentation roadmap and knowledge base to capture learnings and avoid repeating unsuccessful tests. Turn experimentation insights into actionable recommendations for the wider commercial team. Reporting & Commercial Intelligence Build and maintain executive dashboards covering the full DTC business. Develop reporting that provides visibility across acquisition, conversion, customer behaviour, trading and profitability. Focus reporting on leading indicators and forward-looking opportunities rather than simply historical performance. Ensure key stakeholders have access to timely and relevant commercial insights. Identify changes in performance, emerging trends and potential risks before they become significant commercial issues. Continuously improve reporting through automation, AI and more efficient analytical processes. What you’ll bring 2–4 years of experience in Analytics, Commercial Strategy, Growth, eCommerce, Consulting or Digital Performance. Strong commercial thinking and an ability to connect data to business outcomes. Strong Excel and SQL skills. Experience working with GA4, Looker and SQL. Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent, with an understanding of how AI and agents can support day-to-day analytical workflows. Strong understanding of eCommerce and DTC metrics including conversion, AOV, ITO, LTV, retention, CAC, ROAS and profitability. Comfortable working with large datasets and solving ambiguous commercial problems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail. Ability to simplify complex analysis and communicate clear, actionable recommendations to stakeholders. Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. A genuine interest in experimentation, emerging technology and AI-enabled ways of working. Curious, commercially driven and proactive in identifying opportunities rather than waiting for questions to be asked. What we'll bring 25 days annual leave, increasing to 30 days after your first year 30% employee discount across SUMWON STUDIOS brands Ongoing learning and development opportunities Company social events The opportunity to work with a high-performing team building brands at global scale Why Join Us? This is an opportunity to join a business in growth mode. You'll have the chance to make a visible impact, take ownership, move quickly and help shape the future of a multi-brand platform operating across global markets.

description: About Nutritics 💥 Nutritics is redefining how hospitality and foodservice businesses operate. We give organisations complete clarity and control over their food, menus, supply chains, and environmental impact. Trusted by 500+ customers worldwide, from contract caterers and restaurant groups to healthcare and education providers, we are the platform of choice for businesses that take food data seriously. Backed by PE investment, we're scaling rapidly across UK&I and expanding into the US market. Our ambition: to become the world's most trusted food information platform. Nutritics is building a demand generation function to fuel our pipeline and drive revenue growth. Reporting into the Marketing Director, this is a hands-on, technical GTM role owning the strategy and execution of everything that builds qualified pipeline across UK/I and US target sectors. This includes account-based marketing, paid media, SEO, campaign infrastructure and prospect/customer nurture. You'll be commercially accountable for MQL volume and CAC, and you're AI-first in how you work. This is a pivotal hire as Nutritics scales in UK/I & expands into the United States. Main Responsibilities 💻 Demand Gen & ABM Strategy: Own and execute demand generation and ABM strategy across paid search, paid social, email, content syndication, SEO and events/webinars, driving qualified pipeline and nurturing prospects across UK/I and US target segments. Reporting & Analytics: Own MQL volume and CAC by segment. Report weekly to the Marketing Director with a clear, defensible line from spend to pipeline. Track ROI, cost per lead and conversion rates, and use the data to shape future campaigns. Systems & Martech Stack: Build and manage the marketing technology stack and infrastructure end-to-end including CRM/marketing automation platform, event tracking, GTM, GA4, heatmapping and attribution, to run nurture campaigns, track lead engagement and deliver pipeline insight to Sales. CRO & Testing : Design and run statistically valid A/B tests across landing pages, campaigns and lifecycle sequences, document and share learnings. Nurture & Retention: Own prospect and customer nurture and retention programmes in partnership with the Content Marketing Manager. Budget Management : Manage UK/I and US paid media budgets, optimising for pipeline contribution over volume or clicks. Sales & RevOps Partnership: Partner with Sales and RevOps on lead routing, scoring and pipeline review. Career Progression and Development 🚀 At Nutritics, growth is built into how we operate and we believe that the best way for our business to grow is for our people to grow. As we scale internationally with the backing of private equity investment, we create real opportunities for people to stretch their skills, take on new challenges, and shape the future of our platform and our industry. You can expect: Impact and Recognition: Join a team delivering significant global growth where you can feel and see the direct impact of your individual contributions. Expert Collaboration: Learn from working alongside an experienced management team and market leading clients around the world. Structured Growth: Benefit from bi-annual performance reviews and a personalised career development plan tailored to your ambitions. Mentorship and Coaching: Access ongoing support and opportunities to expand your responsibilities as the business scales. Global Pathways: Take advantage of clear progression routes into senior leadership and specialist roles as we continue our international expansion. The Ideal candidate will have🙌 5+ years in a hands-on, technical growth, demand generation or performance marketing role in B2B SaaS or B2B tech. Experience building highly targeted demand gen and ABM campaign activity. A genuine appetite for using AI and the latest tools and tech in how you work. Genuine depth in CRO and A/B testing: comfortable designing statistically valid tests and thinking in systems, not just running one-off experiments. Hands-on management of paid media budgets across LinkedIn and Google, with a track record of optimising for pipeline over vanity metrics. Comfortable owning a marketing tech stack end to end: CRM/marketing automation, analytics and attribution. Proven ability to source, brief and manage external agencies and freelancers as needed. Fluent in English, confident communicating performance data to non-marketing, commercially driven stakeholders Highly Desireable 🙌 Familiarity with AI-assisted landing page builders, or hands-on knowledge of HTML/CSS, Next.js, Supabase or Vercel, for building high-performing landing pages Experience marketing into hospitality, foodservice, food retail or adjacent B2B sectors Experience with Pardot and/or HubSpot and Salesforce Familiarity with ABM platforms (e.g. 6sense, Demandbase, Apollo.io) Background in a scale-up environment, building demand gen from a lean base Traits Commercially minded, focused on pipeline and CAC rather than vanity metrics Technical, can easily navigate sales and martech stacks and is always looking for the best tools to support Hands-on and execution-focused Curious and testing-led, comfortable running experiments and learning fast Collaborative, works well with Content, Sales, RevOps, and external partners and agencies. Clear communicator, comfortable reporting on performance weekly Most Importantly 👍 Nutritics is a people first business scaling at a world class pace, and we are looking for individuals who align with our five core values: T eam First, Open Communication, No Ego, Integrity, and The Rocket 🚀. We take our mission seriously but don’t take ourselves too seriously, fostering a collaborative spirit where transparency, openness and results are valued over hierarchy. By joining us, you become part of an award winning culture that balances high speed international growth with a genuine commitment to the wellbeing and development of every team member. Working with Nutritics 💪 25 days annual leave (plus public holidays), growing the longer you stay with us. Genuine work-life balance, with perks like summer hours and enhanced parenting leave. A generous allowance to support your health and wellbeing. Pension contributions matched by the company. Life Assurance cover. A competitive, market-aligned salary package. Corporate travel insurance. Real opportunities for career growth along diverse and rewarding paths. Ongoing training and development to help you build your skills. A supportive team of experienced, knowledgeable colleagues to learn from. Location and Hours of Work 🌍 Our weekly hours of work are 37.5 covering Monday to Friday. This is a hybrid role and we offer a lot of flexibility around core hours. Teams based in Ireland and the UK are required to work from the local office one day every two weeks. This role can be based either in Ireland or the UK.

description: Job Title: Claims Business Analyst Reporting to: Claims Product Manager Direct Reports : None Position Type: Permanent, 35 hours per week Working Pattern: 3 days in the office and 2 working from home Location: City of London Overview Why Tokio Marine HCC? Reporting to the Claims Product Manager, you will facilitate workshops, document requirements, analyse current and future-state processes, support backlog development and help ensure solutions are fit for purpose. Previous Claims experience and working knowledge of London Market Claims operations and systems are preferred, together with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels. Elicit, analyse, document and validate business and functional requirements using appropriate business analysis techniques. Facilitate workshops, interviews and requirements-gathering sessions across Claims, Operations, Product, Technology and Change teams. Define and validate acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment with agreed business outcomes, control requirements and stakeholder expectations. Support User Acceptance Testing planning and execution, including test scenario development, defect triage, issue clarification and resolution. Maintain requirements traceability and support change control throughout the product or project lifecycle, from initial requirement through deployment and post-release validation. Conduct impact assessments, root-cause analysis and gap analysis to support business and technology change initiatives. Provide analysis and insight to support prioritisation decisions, including business value, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and implementation impacts. Assess and help optimise Claims processes to improve operational efficiency, colleague experience, customer outcomes, data quality and control effectiveness. Contribute effectively in Agile and Waterfall environments, participating in relevant ceremonies, governance forums and delivery activities. Create clear, concise and high-quality deliverables and support knowledge transfer and continuous improvement across the Claims Performance team. Skills and Experience Specification: Essential Demonstrable experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within the insurance industry or another regulated environment. Experience eliciting, analysing, documenting and validating business and functional requirements. Experience producing business requirements documents, epics, features, user stories, use cases and clear acceptance criteria. Experience facilitating requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews, including constructively challenging assumptions and resolving ambiguity. Strong process-mapping skills using recognised modelling techniques and the ability to document processes at appropriate levels of detail. Experience creating and maintaining requirements traceability and supporting backlog refinement. Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing and working with business and testing teams throughout the delivery lifecycle. Experience working within Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies. Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. Understanding of the regulatory, compliance and control environment in which an insurance company operates. Strong stakeholder management, written communication and influencing skills, including the ability to explain business and technical concepts clearly. Understanding of insurance business processes, organisational structures and capability models. Proficiency in Excel for analysis, validation and requirements support, and experience working with delivery tools such as Azure DevOps or equivalent. Desirable Previous experience of Claims processes, Claims operations and the end-to-end policy and claims journey. Working knowledge of London Market Claims systems and platforms, such as ECF2, Guidewire ClaimCenter, Sequel Claims or Genius. Experience working closely with Product Owners or Product Managers in a product-led environment. Exposure to Claims transformation or wider business change programmes. Experience of Target Operating Model design, business capability modelling or process taxonomy development. Experience producing entity relationship diagrams or supporting data analysis, reporting and Power BI requirements. Experience collaborating with data engineering teams or working with cloud-based data platforms. Experience applying strategic analysis techniques where relevant to business change. Professional Business Analysis qualification from BCS, IIBA or an equivalent body. London Market qualifications such as LM1, LM2 or LM3. We are a successful, dynamic organization experiencing rapid growth and are seeking energetic and confident individuals to join our team of professionals. The Tokio Marine HCC Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer. Please visit www.tmhcc.com for more information about our companies.

description: Who We Are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong product judgment backed by data fluency, a track record of personally owning shipped software products that moved measurable business results, and the ability to ruthlessly prioritize and lead cross-functional teams to ship repeatedly and at pace. Develop the product roadmap, align internal stakeholders to the strategy, and contribute to the long-term product vision. Partner with cross-functional teams (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Support) to execute product development and go-to-market strategies. Prioritize features and epics by balancing short-term commercial goals against long-term strategic investments and technical debt. Define and track qualitative and quantitative reporting mechanisms to monitor product outcomes and measure ongoing success. Collaborate with sales and retention teams to execute feedback loops (such as win-loss and satisfaction analysis) and integrate insights into planning. Translate customer needs into user stories and feature epics while clearly communicating the "Why" and business objectives to all stakeholders. Promote best practices to continuously improve the Product Management practice at Geotab. What You’ll Bring To This Role: Bachelors in a related field, Post-secondary Diploma/Degree, or equivalent work experience (Degree specialization in Engineering, Business, Computer Science or a related field highly valued). 5+ years of required previous experience in product management, customer discovery, or a related field, ideally within a SaaS environment. A track record of products you personally owned that reached real users and moved measurable business results. Strong product judgment backed by data fluency (comfort with SQL or analytics tooling is a plus). Proven ability to get a cross-functional team to ship, repeatedly and at pace. Experience in telematics, video, IoT, safety, B2B SaaS, or zero-to-one / early-stage / scale-up environments is a strong plus. You’ll collaborate with top industry professionals, gain hands on experience with cutting edge technologies, and deliver solutions that create real business impact. From day one, you’ll work on meaningful, high profile programmes that stretch your skills and accelerate your growth. We invest heavily in you—supporting continuous learning, in demand skills development, and long term career progression. You’ll thrive in a flexible, inclusive environment that values curiosity, encourages reinvention, and recognises what makes you unique. We Offer Tools and policies to support your work-life balance from flexible working approaches, sabbatical programs, paid paternity leave, maternity leave and an innovative maternity returners scheme More traditional benefits, such as 25 days holiday (in addition to public holidays), private medical, dental & optical cover, online shopping discounts, an Employee Assistance Program, life assurance and a group pension plan through salary sacrifice. Your Role And Responsibilities We are looking for a Technical Business Analyst to join our delivery team and help shape high quality digital and technology solutions. In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, testers, and vendors to gather and document requirements, analyse problems, and ensure that technical solutions meet business needs. You will translate complex business objectives into clear functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. You will support all stages of the SDLC, helping teams understand dependencies, evaluate impacts, and deliver high quality outcomes. Your ability to communicate clearly, analyse issues, and facilitate workshops will be essential as you help shape solution design and guide delivery teams. As a Technical BA, you will also bring a practical understanding of how systems integrate, how APIs and data flows behave, and how non functional requirements influence technology decisions. Depending on your experience, you may lead requirement workstreams, mentor other analysts, or contribute to account level planning and stakeholder management. If you enjoy solving complex problems, engaging with both business and technical teams, and helping deliver solutions that add real value, we would love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities Gather and document business and functional requirements. Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and use cases. Perform gap analysis, impact analysis, and solution assessments. Work with developers, testers, architects, and vendors to clarify requirements. Support Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning and backlog refinement. Assist with testing activities by validating requirements and reviewing results. Depending on experience, help guide workshops, mentor team members, or support stakeholder engagement. Preferred Education Bachelor's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise Strong requirement gathering and documentation skills Functional specification writing (user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases) Impact analysis and gap analysis SDLC knowledge (Agile, iterative, and traditional models) Process mapping (BPMN or equivalent) Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and system interactions Ability to read/interpret technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and data flow diagrams Understanding of non-functional requirement categories Strong communication and stakeholder management Workshop facilitation Problem‑solving, analytical thinking, and structured reasoning Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, testers, architects, and vendors This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). description: Transguard Group was established in 2001 and has diversified significantly, we lead in the fields of Cash Services, Security Services, Manpower Services, Facilities Management & Aviation. Transguard Group is nation's most trusted business support and outsourcing provider and has a large, dynamic and culturally diverse workforce with 80,000 employees! We are currently recruiting for a Business Analyst - IT Projects to join our Information Communication and Technology team at our Headquarters, located in DAFZA (Dubai Airport Freezone). Scope: The Business Analyst serves as a liaison between business stakeholders and the IT department, translating business requirements into technical solutions. This role requires a blend of business acumen, analytical skills, and technical expertise to identify opportunities for process improvement, facilitate the implementation of IT solutions, and ensure alignment between business goals and IT initiatives. Financial Conduct thorough analysis of business processes, workflows, and systems to identify areas for improvement, efficiency gains, and automation opportunities Customer Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their objectives, processes, and requirements, and translate them into clear and actionable business and functional specifications. Facilitate requirements gathering sessions, workshops, and interviews with stakeholders to elicit, document, and prioritize business and technical requirements. Work closely with internal and external developers and BUs to ensure that technical solutions meet business requirements and are delivered on time and within budget. Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT) and gather feedback from stakeholders to validate that IT solutions meet their needs and expectations. Provide training, user support, and documentation to enable end-users to effectively utilize new or enhanced IT systems and applications. Process Analyze and document complex business problems and propose innovative, technology-driven solutions to address them, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and strategies. Develop detailed business and functional requirements documents, user stories, use cases, and other artifacts to communicate requirements to IT development teams. Conduct feasibility studies, impact assessments, and risk analyses to evaluate proposed solutions and identify potential constraints or dependencies. Participate in the design, configuration, and testing of IT systems and applications, providing guidance and support to ensure successful implementation and adoption. Monitor and evaluate the performance and effectiveness of IT solutions post-implementation, and recommend enhancements or optimizations as needed. Innovation Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in IT and business analysis, and share knowledge and insights with the team. Selection Criteria Bachelor's degree in business administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; master's degree or MBA is a plus. Proven experience as a business analyst or related role, preferably in an IT environment. Strong understanding of business processes, requirements elicitation, and analysis techniques. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex business needs into practical solutions. Solid understanding of software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall) and proficiency in requirements management tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Projects). Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Experience with business process modeling and documentation tools (e.g., BPMN, Visio) is desirable. Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) are a plus.
