description: Job Purpose At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world to and through our global hub in Dubai, and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’. Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-edge information and technology team as a Technical Product Owner. Join our Technical Product Management team, where we build effective technology products and services that our customers love. We offer a mix of B2B and B2C products and services in domains such as Digital, Airline and Airport Operations, Group Services, and Commercial. Our goal is to continuously evolve our products, enriching them with features that focus on delivering value to our customers and users. If you are passionate about creating impactful technology products and ensuring their success, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the innovation and excellence at Emirates Group. The Technical Product Owner – Finance is an expert in the finance domain, who understands Finance capabilities with experience in implementing, integrating and managing a diverse range of Finance solutions such as ERP, in-house built products, etc. They bring value to an organisation and engage the business to refine, validate and deliver solutions on the existing Finance products and/or enhancing their capabilities. As the Technical Product Owner for the Finance teams, you will lead the team supporting a diverse range of Finance products, managing the product backlog of features and enhancements from discovery through to value delivery and ongoing support. In This Role, You Will Be Responsible for the story content, acceptance criteria definition, and end story "sign off" across team backlogs, ensuring prepared on time for future PIs, refined frequently with the entire team, and prioritised accordingly in alignment with other team backlogs. Ensures Technical Debt and Non-functional requirements are captured, refined, and prioritised across all sprints. Captures additional BAU, Ceremony, and Spike activities, and incorporates them into team backlogs, within the boundaries of available capacity. Prepare contribution to PI demo, in conjunction with other applicable Product Owners. Maintain the quality and integrity of features within their technical and team boundaries, ensuring identification and contribution of risks and dependencies back to the Product Portfolio backlog. Attends and contributes to key Product Management meetings, in particular PI Planning. Defines metrics to measure the success and performance of prioritised work, ensuring any further. BAU iterations can be proposed and prioritised accordingly within the boundaries of available capacity. Participates in establishing and growing a community of Product Owners, building an identity for the role, focusing on collaboration, and identifying opportunities for improvement and growth. Contribute to the Product Management Communities and their continual evolution to help drive efficient practices and empowered teams. Working with your team(s) to identify and capture team-driven innovation ideas, consolidating across peer groups for playback up to the TPM (Technical Product Manager) community. Qualification To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements: Degree or honours (12+3 or equivalent). 5+ years of experience in Information Technology or other. Knowledge/Skills Operations Research, Marketing Science, Information Systems, e-Commerce, or a combination of industry certification. 2+ years of practical experience working as a Product Owner/Manager, in a 'team-facing' capacity, with a proven record of driving discernible change and delivery at pace. Whilst not essential, some experience of working within a Scaled Agile framework, across multiple initiatives and circa 50+ teams. Demonstrated technical or domain expertise, utilising a depth and breadth of knowledge and practical experience within the specific domain or technical area. Stays up to date with regulatory and other changes in the technical area, and understands how they apply to the Emirates group. Well-versed with the tools for the Product Management aspects of software delivery. Strong and concise communicator at peer, line, and stakeholder levels. Builds strong relationships with peers and team members. Appetite for building and identifying value, with a customer-centric mindset. Leadership Role: Yes Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.

description: instashop, headquartered in Dubai, is the leading online local marketplace in the UAE and Egypt . Since joining the Delivery Hero family in 2020, the global leader in online food delivery and q-commerce, instashop has been setting the standard for excellence and convenience in the region. With a dynamic and motivated team fueled by passion and innovation, every day at instashop is an opportunity for growth and success. We champion inclusivity, diversity and collaboration, creating an environment where everyone’s achievements are celebrated and where success is the only way forward. As we continue to grow, our team keeps expanding across the UAE, Egypt and Greece, and we’re always on the lookout for new talents to join us on our success journey. Job Description Strong hands-on SQL skills are essential, along with experience analysing business and marketing performance and an interest in using AI to make analytics faster, more scalable, and more impactful. Analyse business performance across growth, customer behaviour, revenue, profitability, marketing, and operations. Independently write and optimise SQL queries to extract and analyse large datasets. Conduct deep dives to identify trends, performance gaps, growth opportunities, and key business drivers. Analyse customer behaviour across acquisition, activation, retention, churn, frequency, cohorts, segmentation, and customer value. Analyse marketing and campaign performance across relevant channels, connecting marketing activity to customer acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue. Evaluate marketing efficiency metrics such as CAC/CARC, ROAS, conversion, campaign uplift, and customer quality, and recommend opportunities to improve targeting and budget allocation. Support customer segmentation and targeting strategies using behavioural, lifecycle, frequency, and value-based cohorts. Conduct pre/post, cohort, benchmark, and incrementality-style analyses to evaluate campaigns, promotions, and business initiatives. Support business cases, forecasting, scenario modelling, and impact estimation for new initiatives. Build dashboards and recurring reports using BI and visualisation tools, with clear visibility across business and marketing KPIs. Partner with Marketing, Product, Commercial, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to define KPIs and provide clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Translate complex analysis into clear insights and actions for business stakeholders. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytical outputs and underlying measurement logic. AI in Analytics The candidate should actively use AI as part of the analytics workflow , including: Accelerating SQL development, debugging, and analysis. Structuring analytical approaches and generating hypotheses. Automating repetitive reporting and analytical tasks. Supporting faster campaign, customer, and marketing performance analysis. Improving insight generation, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Building reusable analytical workflows or AI-assisted processes that improve team productivity and scalability. Qualifications 3-5 years of experience in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy Analytics, Growth Analytics, or a related field. Strong hands-on SQL skills. Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills. Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Metabase, or similar. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and structured thinking skills. Ability to translate data into clear business recommendations. Comfortable working with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. Practical exposure to generative AI tools in analytical workflows. Nice to Have Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, quick commerce, retail, fintech, or consumer technology. Exposure to Python. Understanding of A/B testing and experimentation. Experience with customer lifecycle, marketing, pricing, retention, churn, or unit economics.

Design, execute and evaluate integrated marketing campaigns across online/offline channels and within/outside the app (including user acquisition, activation, retention, and major promotions) to strengthen user awareness of Alipay+ payment availability and deals, so as to drive business growth. Collaborate with business development team to identify and manage key merchant accounts across different categories (F&B, attractions, retail, etc.) in the market, in order to win trust, establish joint marketing partnerships and drive their publicity and payment volume. Requirements Bachelor's degree or above in Business, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing, growth, or business operations within a consumer internet, fintech, payments, travel, or digital platform company. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin. Excellent Chinese copywriting and content localisation skills. Good understanding of the global digital marketing landscape and consumer behavior, with strong knowledge of the mainland China internet ecosystem, user behavior, social media platforms, and marketing trends. Good-To Haves Experience in online-to-offline (O2O), digital payments, fintech, e-commerce, travel, or other consumer internet industries, with a proven track record of driving user acquisition, engagement, and business growth, is preferred. Strategic thinker with strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills, while remaining hands-on in execution. Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic, and often ambiguous environment, with the flexibility to adapt to changing business priorities. Curious, resilient, proactive, and highly adaptable, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure. Strong problem-solving, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work independently. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to collaborate across cross-functional, cross-regional, and external teams, build alignment, and drive execution. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity and workflow efficiency is an advantage.

Ensure optimal and timely delivery of prioritised initiatives/changes in conjunction with Technology and Business Stakeholders. Position Accountabilities The key position requirements are: Work within an agile environment; attend daily stand-ups, iteration/sprint testing, sprint planning and retrospectives. Identify areas for improvement or optimisation, solve product-related problems, make decisions to stay on track towards business deliverables commitments; Possess a fundamental understanding of end-to-end customer experience integration and dependencies; Work closely with other Product Owners to ensure the shared customer experience vision is maintained, channel performance and satisfaction is continually monitored, and that customer experience is kept at the forefront of all decisions; Collaborate effectively with Digital teams to ensure a high level of communication, consultation and testing on any effecting changes; Represent business stakeholders in maintaining system functionality and business logic; o Manage risks, issues and dependencies between backlog items and multiple stakeholders; Work with the testing team to ensure appropriate testing is performed on all releases; Manage and collaborate with cross-functional teams, business partners and stakeholders for a product(s). WHS is everyone’s responsibility Essential What experience you’ll bring (Qualifications and Experience) Minimum 2 years of experience working in Agile Methodologies Minimum 2 years of Business Analysis experience or equivalent qualification Demonstrated project, time and prioritisation management skills essential Experience leading teams in either a business or project context Experience in stakeholder engagement & management Knowledge or experience in General Insurance or Financial Services highly regarded Relevant tertiary qualifications or certifications Location: Toowong Close to a variety of public transport and easy parking options, the Toowong office has excellent end-of-trip facilities (including secure bike storage and showers), outdoor spaces and plenty of modern collaborative areas to work and connect with colleagues. Conveniently based at Toowong Village tower with views of the mountains and the Brisbane River, our location is only 4 km from the city and provides access to retail, restaurants and other amenities. Access to A&G’s employee reward and recognition platform, powered by Rewards Gateway - Enjoy a wide range of benefits, including: Personalised rewards and peer-to-peer recognition Exclusive discounts and savings across more than 600 top retailers A comprehensive recognition program that celebrates milestones and achievements—helping you feel valued every step of the way Work flexibility - with options to work from home two days per week. Our range of general insurance products including Car, Motorcycle, Home, Contents Pet and Travel products are delivered through our multi-award-winning brand Budget Direct and partnerships with leading brands - ING, Qantas and Coles Insurance. description: Vill du äga digital growth – och samtidigt vara den som faktiskt får saker att hända? Segers söker en Growth Marketing Manager som vill ta ett tydligt ansvar för vår digitala tillväxt och fortsätta utveckla vår e-commerce. Det här är inte en roll där du enbart analyserar, sätter strategi och lämnar genomförandet till andra. Vi söker dig som är senior nog att äga growth-agendan och operativ nog att själv göra jobbet . Du arbetar mot tydliga kommersiella mål och har stort mandat att själv identifiera, prioritera och driva de initiativ som krävs för att nå dem. Rollen Shopify och vår e-commerce är centrala arbetsytor. Du kommer bland annat att: äga och utveckla Segers digitala tillväxt med fokus på lönsam försäljning arbeta hands-on i Shopify Plus och kontinuerligt utveckla kundresan analysera kundbeteende, försäljning och produktdata och omsätta insikter till konkreta förbättringar driva CRO, tester och experiment för att förbättra konvertering, AOV och kundvärde utveckla arbetet med CRM, retention och marketing automation ansvara för budget, prognos och uppföljning av den digitala affären arbeta med KPI:er och dashboards för att förstå vad som driver resultat samarbeta nära marknad, sälj och externa specialister inom exempelvis paid, analytics och teknisk utveckling. Du ingår i ett litet marknadsteam där vi har olika spetskompetenser men arbetar tillsammans mot samma kommersiella mål. Vem söker vi? Vi tror att du har flera års erfarenhet av e-commerce, digital försäljning eller growth och har mycket god praktisk erfarenhet av Shopify – gärna Shopify Plus . Du är van vid att självständigt driva digital utveckling mot tydliga affärsmål och har erfarenhet av CRO, analys och digital kundresa. Kunskap inom CRM, retention och marketing automation är viktig. Erfarenhet av HubSpot är meriterande – men för den här rollen väger stark Shopify- och e-commercekompetens tyngre . Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och kommersiellt driven. Du väntar inte på en färdig aktivitetsplan utan identifierar själv vad som behöver göras, prioriterar och driver arbetet från idé till genomförande och uppföljning. Och kanske viktigast av allt: du gillar att göra. Om Segers Segers har utvecklat professionella arbetskläder sedan 1943. Vi har våra rötter i Borås och arbetar nära människorna som bär våra plagg – inom restaurang, hotell och hospitality. Nu fortsätter vi utveckla både Segers och vår digitala affär, med ambitionen att växa utanför våra nordiska hemmamarknader. Designed in Sweden. Crafted in Europe. Worn by those who know. Rollen är placerad på Segers kontor i Viared, Borås. Har du frågor om tjänsten, kontakta Mia Kinn, mia.kinn@segers.com Sista ansökningsdag 2026-10-30

description: GoHenry Data Analyst GoHenry is a UK-based fintech company created by parents to pioneer financial education. More recently, GoHenry moved into Europe and the US by joining forces with French fintech company PixPay and US investing app, Acorns. Together, Acorns, PixPay, and GoHenry have over 6 million members across 5 countries. We are focused on empowering families with engaging money management tools, educational content, and a seamless product experience that creates financial well-being from birth to adulthood. Join us on our mission to make every kid smart with money! GoHenry is seeking an experienced and self-driven Data Analyst to be a pivotal part of our Data team, providing insights that drive our product forward and help millions of kids and teens build good financial habits. Key technologies are BigQuery, Dataform, Tableau, Veezoo, Amplitude and Monte Carlo. This role is based in our London office, with the flexibility to work remotely provided you are willing to travel to London when needed. You will be a key member of the Data team, a vibrant group of analysts and engineers dedicated to mastering our craft. What you will do at GoHenry: Work with people across the business to deeply understand their objectives, providing analysis and insight to drive the product forwards. Present critical insights and strategic recommendations to others in a way that is impactful but easy to understand. Proactively perform in-depth data analysis to identify and understand anomalies. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to structure, run, and analyse A/B tests, using statistical techniques to ensure reliable findings that improve the customer experience. Design, build, test, deploy and monitor data models and semantic models, following all best practices and team standards and processes. Share knowledge with other team members, playing an active role in the wider data team. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data practices, taking on new challenges as the team grows. What you will bring to GoHenry: Essential: Very strong knowledge of SQL in a data warehouse environment. Experience building robust and compelling dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau. Good working knowledge of product experimentation techniques and statistical methods. Experience using a data transformation tool such as dbt or Dataform. A curiosity and desire to learn how GoHenry works, and gain a deep understanding of the product structure and business models. Previous experience working as a data analyst, ideally in a B2C environment. A team player fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills. A hunger to continually improve yourself and others, using the latest technologies such as Claude Code to increase impact. Desirable: Good working knowledge of BigQuery. Experience building semantic models / knowledge graphs, or a desire to learn. Experience working with event analytic platforms such as Amplitude. What's in it for you? All the essentials you would expect, including a workplace pension plan, 33 days of holiday (including public holidays), & great company events local & abroad! Other Offers: GoFlex - Work from Home, Office, or a mix of both Your Birthday Day off 25 days annual leave, in addition to 8 UK bank holidays An excellent Induction & onboarding program with ongoing learning & development throughout your career A choice between Bupa Health Cash Plan or Bupa Private Medical Death in service – 4x your annual salary from month 1 Physical and Mental Wellbeing support and platforms for you and your family Family-friendly leave policies Enhanced maternity leave – 20 weeks full basic pay after 2 years’ service and 26 weeks full basic pay after 3 years’ service Paternity leave – 4 weeks full pay after probation Salary Sacrifice options About GoHenry We’re on a mission to help every kid be smart with money. Our goal? Create generations of independent, confident young adults, armed with money skills that will set them up for life. How we do it: We place the power in the hands of young people, giving them the tools they need to master the financial ropes for themselves. They can spend, save, earn, and give with GoHenry’s prepaid debit card and app – because learning through doing really works (and it’s more fun!). All while our unique built-in controls give parents total peace of mind. We’re proud to say... We ranked #38 in Newsweek's Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces in the UK in 2023 We’re one of Tech Track’s top 50 fastest-growing UK companies. We won Finders Kid’s Cards Customer Satisfaction Awards in 2022 and 2023. We won the Tech for Good award at the Better Society Awards 2023 Our kids and parents have donated over £500,000 of their own money to NSPCC via their GoHenry accounts But we’re still growing, and that’s why we need you. GoHenry is an equal-opportunity employer, and we’re on a mission to foster a diverse & inclusive workplace. Individuals seeking employment at GoHenry are considered without regard to race, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description: Looking for a challenge in one of the world’s largest airfreight logistics organisations? At IAG Cargo we are in the business of moving things. From antibiotics to groundbreaking tech, gold bullion to avocados and everything in between. We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need. We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver. About The Role Reporting directly to one of our Heads of Technology, the Product Owner role has end-to-end accountability for critical technology products within the assigned business area, including Salesforce-based platforms across Sales, Customer Service, and Commercial operations of IAG Cargo. This role acts as a liaison between IT development groups and business units in order to establish a full product roadmap. They will be responsible for the full lifecycle of these technology products, managing the product backlog, timely delivery of features, enhancements and bug fixes and management of associated technology vendors. The Product Owner will liaise with Service Operations and Cyber teams to ensure the ongoing operation of the technology meets service level requirements, both from a functional and non-functional perspective. What You’ll Do Technology Accountability: Overall accountability for the entire lifecycle of assigned business area technology products (from design, build through to BAU), including CRM platforms such as Salesforce (e.g. Sales Cloud, Service Cloud), ensuring alignment with enterprise platform strategy. Relationship Management: Serve as the main point of contact between business stakeholders, customers, and the development team. Act as the voice of the customer to ensure technology solutions meet their needs effectively and provide clear recommendations to support informed decision-making. Business Expertise: Understand the underlying business of the technology product and collaborate with the Product Manager in order to identify product opportunities, shape the vision and define the product roadmap with a strong understanding of CRM-driven processes such as customer management, sales pipelines, and case handling, and their integration with wider enterprise systems and customer data platforms. Product Backlog Management: Manage and prioritise the product backlog, ensuring features, user stories, and bug fixes are well-defined with clear acceptance criteria and aligned with business priorities and product roadmap, ensuring optimal use of platform capabilities (e.g. standard vs custom Salesforce functionality). Change Delivery: Accountable for the successful delivery of all changes to the product, whether project-driven, small changes, or bug fixes. Development Oversight: Lead and participate in all Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning and retrospectives, collaborating with QA teams to resolve issues before release, ensuring alignment with Salesforce release cycles, platform constraints, and best practices. Continuous Improvement: Continuously improve product development processes for better efficiency and communication. Quality Assurance: Ensure underlying technology meets performance service levels, identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions including compliance with internal cyber, architectural, and data standards, as well as relevant industry regulations and policies, and adherence to Salesforce platform governance, data model integrity, and integration standards. Product Support: Work closely with Service Operations and support partners, to ensure the day-to-day operations of the product meets operational SLAs and customer expectations, ensuring effective support models for SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, including incident, release, and change management. Supplier Management: Act as point of escalation to the vendor, including Salesforce delivery and support partners, for any delivery or operational issues. Knowledge Management: Build the internal knowledge base product features, processes, and updates and become the product “subject matter expert”, including platform capabilities, limitations, and roadmap (e.g. Salesforce releases and features). Industry Expertise: Monitor industry trends relevant to the product and its customers, including competitor activities, emerging technology and supplier landscape. Value Realisation: Define and track product outcomes, ensuring delivery is aligned to measurable business value and strategic outcomes (e.g. adoption, efficiency, revenue impact), not just feature completion. It's All About You What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo: Demonstrates clear leadership and an ability to influence and persuade across the organisation at senior levels, leading by example and aligning stakeholder groups around a common vision. Collaborative, open working, resulting in recognition as a valued partner by colleagues, customers and senior stakeholders across the organisation. Sound judgement, attention to detail, solution focused and ability to make effective decisions in a fast-paced environment. The ability to communicate complex ideas in a clear, concise manner (verbal and written) across functional and technical departments. Ability to work on multiple tasks at any one time, handling conflicting demands, prioritize workload and effectively delegation while maintaining high quality standards. High emotional intelligence and solid interpersonal and relationship building skills. Strong analytical and product management skills required, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer/business needs together with the technology platform road map into manageable product backlog user stories. Entrepreneurial self-starter who is self-motivated but also a team player Experience in leading cross-functional teams and motivating them to go the extra mile. Advocate of Digital and Agile approaches, drive simplicity and scalability. Strong understanding of CRM platforms (preferably Salesforce) and the ability to leverage out‑of‑the‑box capabilities to deliver scalable business solutions Skills And Experience Essential Experience: Proven experience working in agile environments and familiarity with agile lifecycle management tools. 2-3 years of experience in a product-focused role, with experience working in the Airline or Logistics Insurance industry. Desirable Experience Experience with SaaS products and vendors. Experience in establishing product teams and ways of working. Experience working with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms in a product or delivery capacity. We’ll treat you right Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference. As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include: A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home. From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family. Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead. All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language courses For health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First Aiders Access to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work Diversity and Inclusion Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda. All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.

description: Work at OMRON! Omron Robotics and Safety Technologies, Inc. (ORT) is a global leading provider of intelligent vision-guided robotics systems and services. We develop social needs driven solutions for the global automation market. Our robotics systems provide unmatched performance and economic value throughout the production lifecycle, enabling customers to achieve precision, quality and productivity in their assembly, handling and packaging processes in a safer and greener environment. We develop new electronics, mechanics and software for an exceptionally broad spectrum of robots – including autonomous mobile robots, articulated robots, parallel link robots, and more. Our product development teams have a passion for innovation, and a record of accomplishment of developing successful products for the global market, and revolutionize interaction between human and machine! ORT is subsidiary of Omron Corporation, a $8 billion global technology company celebrating more than 90 years of success. We are seeking a Product Owner, Fleet Management & Cloud to support ORT’s transition to a value stream–oriented operating model. This role is responsible for execution, backlog ownership, and delivery of ORT’s fleet management and cloud software offerings, working in close partnership with engineering teams and the Global Product Manager for this value stream. This position reports to the Director, Mobile Product Management. The role operates in close partnership with Global Product Managers aligned to the same value stream, with a focus on software execution, Agile delivery, and customer‑driven outcomes. This role can be based at any Omron Robotics location in the Americas or Europe. Our Commitment to Employees: Training and Career Development Program to give employees a learning path with the necessary tools and resources they need to help build their career at Omron. Great financial opportunities with competitive compensation, immediate 401k match with 100% vesting, profit sharing, and Blue Cross Blue Shield for medical, dental, vision and prescription drug benefits. Community Programs that include activities with local non-profit organizations and a Matching Gift Program. Work-Life Balance with Flexible Work Arrangements, Flexible Work Hours, and Sick/Vacation/Holiday Pay. Wellness Programs such as Walking Contests, Nutritional Learning Sessions, On Site Flu shots or Health Screenings, etc. Education Assistance Program. Responsibilities: Own and maintain the product backlog for Fleet Management & Cloud software, translating roadmap priorities into well‑defined user stories and acceptance criteria. Enable Agile value stream teams by directing feature and defect prioritization, collaborating closely with stakeholders to clarify scope, resolve dependencies, and remove delivery blockers. Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives alongside software developers and other stakeholders, including the Software Architect. Ensure engineering efforts are aligned to customer workflows, business value, and value stream objectives, not just feature output. Collaborate closely with the Global Product Manager to align sprint outcomes to roadmap goals, releases, and commercial priorities. Work with UX, systems engineering, and architecture stakeholders to ensure solutions scale across cloud, IT/OT integration, and customer environments. Participate in customer engagement, feedback loops, and internal demos to ensure validated learning informs backlog priorities. Support release planning, coordination, and internal enablement for Fleet Management & Cloud deployments. Actively identify and remove execution blockers to maintain delivery velocity and product quality. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent experience considered. 5+ years of experience working in software product ownership, product management, or Agile delivery roles. Hands‑on experience working with Agile development teams in a B2B software environment. Prior experience with cloud‑based platforms, enterprise software, or industrial systems. To conform with U.S. export control regulations, applicant should be eligible for any required authorization from the U.S. Government. Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog management, story writing, and sprint execution. Ability to translate customer and market needs into clear, actionable software requirements. Comfortable making day‑to‑day tradeoff decisions that balance scope, quality, and delivery speed. Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate across engineering, product, UX, and commercial teams. Analytical mindset with attention to detail and quality. Preferred: Experience with fleet management software, IoT platforms, or IT/OT integration. Preferred: Familiarity with cloud architectures, APIs, and enterprise software deployment models. Preferred: background working in robotics, automation, or industrial technology environments. description: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. Your Role: Alpaca is building the infrastructure layer that partners across the Gulf use to launch and scale brokerage products. We're expanding our footprint in Saudi Arabia and the UAE — with live market access, a growing regional roadmap, and ambitions across derivatives, direct connectivity, securities lending, and Sharia-compliant offerings. We're hiring a Product Manager to own that expansion end-to-end: define the strategy, ship the products, and work with regulators, partners, and internal teams to make Alpaca the brokerage platform of choice across the Kingdom and the wider GCC. We're seeking a Product Manager to define and drive new product initiatives and manage a portfolio of existing products across the Saudi and GCC markets. With a deep understanding of the regional regulatory landscape, including CMA, Edaa, Tadawul, and GCC financial market frameworks, you will shape the product strategy that enables Alpaca to scale its brokerage infrastructure across the Kingdom and the wider Gulf region, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 and the region's rapidly evolving capital markets. This role is equal parts strategy and delivery. You'll decide what we build versus buy, how we sequence the regional roadmap, and which partnerships and connectivity paths get us there — and then ship the brokerage features, integrations, and operational workflows that partners and institutional clients depend on every day. What You'll Walk Into You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems: Saudi limited live: scaling from initial market access to full product coverage while meeting CMA and Tadawul requirements. The rest of the Saudi roadmap: prioritizing and delivering the next wave of brokerage capabilities across equities, Sukuk, ETFs, and regional market needs. Saudi derivatives: defining and launching derivative product offerings compliant with local market structure and regulation. Saudi direct connectivity: building and owning connectivity to Tadawul and regional infrastructure, reducing reliance on intermediary paths. Saudi broker partnerships: evaluating, onboarding, and integrating local brokers to expand coverage and resilience. Saudi securities lending business: growing the securities lending product line for the Kingdom. All of the above for the UAE: replicating and adapting the Saudi playbook for the Emirates market, including local regulatory alignment and partner integrations. Sharia-compliant products across Alpaca: owning the product strategy and delivery for Islamic finance offerings, ensuring Sharia-compliant structures are embedded across regional and global product surfaces. Regulatory and stakeholder complexity: engagements with CMA, Tadawul, Edaa, and other regional regulators, plus coordination between Alpaca's global platform and KSA/GCC market infrastructure. Things You Get To Do Own brokerage products tailored for the Saudi and GCC markets, including equities, Sukuk, ETFs, derivatives, and Sharia-compliant solutions. Drive brokerage product strategy by analyzing ROI, regional market competition, regulatory requirements, and build-vs-buy scenarios. Contribute to the product roadmap with a focus on CMA-compliant features, Sharia-compliant solutions, and regional market needs. Write product requirements and work with engineers to execute programs that meet local regulatory and market standards. Improve brokerage operation efficiency by providing solutions and owning the metrics, with a focus on regional settlement, custody, and clearing workflows. Lead customer calls around brokerage process and product issues to gain insights and translate them into product improvements for GCC clients. Participate in engagements with the CMA, Tadawul, Edaa, and other regional regulators to drive product strategy and ensure regulatory alignment. Report timely and accurately on product status and results to internal and external stakeholders, including regional partners and institutional clients. Collaborate with local operations teams to ensure seamless integration between Alpaca's global platform and KSA/GCC market infrastructure. — Who You Are (Must-Haves) Excited about what Alpaca is building and passionate about expanding financial infrastructure across the GCC. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, finance, or equivalent. 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Engineering, Consulting, and/or starting a startup, preferably within financial services or fintech. Demonstrated interest and experience in brokerage, capital markets, or fintech within the Saudi or GCC region. Strong understanding of the CMA regulatory framework, Tadawul market structure, and GCC capital markets landscape. Strong communication skills in both Arabic and English, both written and verbal, with excellent collaboration abilities. Business acumen to understand tradeoffs between stakeholders and technology feasibility with time and budget constraints. Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves) Experience and background working on and developing brokerage products in the Saudi or GCC markets. Technical background working with APIs, particularly in financial services or trading platforms. CME-1 or other CMA-recognized professional certifications. Experience working with Qualified Foreign Investor (QFI) programs or cross-border investment products. Familiarity with Sharia-compliant product structures and Islamic finance principles. Experience working at a fintech, startup, or CMA-authorized institution. description: About Klook We are Asia’s leading platform for experiences and travel services, and we believe that we can help bring the world closer together through experiences . Do you share our belief in the wonders of travel? Our international community of over 1,800 employees, based in 30+ locations, certainly do! Global citizens ourselves, Klookers are not only curating memorable experiences for others but also co-creating our world of joy within Klook. We work hard and play hard, upkeeping our high-performing culture as we are guided daily by our 6 core values: Customer First Push Boundaries Critical Thinking Build for Scale Less is More Win as One We never settle, and together, we believe in achieving greater heights and realizing endless possibilities ahead of us in the dynamic new era of travel. Care to be a part of this revolution? Join us! Job Summary Klook, a leading travel and experiences platform, is seeking a strategic and results-driven Manager, Business Strategy and Operations (Google channels) to lead the development and execution of business strategies leveraging Google’s paid and non-paid channels . This role will focus on driving traffic, optimizing marketing performance, and enhancing operational efficiency to support Klook’s travel offerings. The ideal candidate is a data-driven leader with deep expertise in Google marketing ecosystems, business strategy, and cross-functional collaboration, capable of aligning marketing initiatives with Klook’s growth objectives. What You'll Do Strategy Development: Design and implement comprehensive strategies leveraging Google’s paid (Google Ads, Things To Do Ads) and non-paid channels (SEO) to drive traffic for Klook’s travel products. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze key performance metrics (e.g., cost per acquisition, conversion rate, ROI, organic traffic growth) using tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads Manager, and Looker to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform strategic decisions. Operational Excellence: Streamline marketing operations by implementing processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency, cross-team collaboration, and scalability of Google channel initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Vertical Planning, Product, Data, and Regional Marketing teams to align channel strategies with broader business goals and ensure consistent messaging across touchpoints. Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify trends, and opportunities, translating insights into actionable marketing strategies. Innovation & Growth: Identify and lead experimental initiatives to explore growth opportunities and maintain a competitive edge. Stakeholder Reporting: Present performance insights, strategic recommendations, and ROI analyses to leadership, articulating the impact of marketing efforts on business growth. What You'll Need Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred. 5+ years of experience in strategy, operations and / or project management. Digital marketing, with at least 3 years focused on Google marketing channels (Google Ads, SEO, YouTube) in a B2C environment, preferably in travel, e-commerce, or tech would be a plus. Strong analytical skills with proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Ads Manager, Search Console, and data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau). Experience managing P&Ls and/or marketing budgets and optimizing spend for maximum ROI. Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage multiple priorities. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and articulate complex strategies clearly. Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications are highly desirable. What You'll Get Be part of a fast-growing, innovative travel platform shaping the future of global travel experiences. Opportunity to lead high-impact marketing strategies in a dynamic, competitive industry. Collaborative and inclusive work environment with a focus on innovation and growth. Competitive compensation package, including [insert relevant benefits, e.g., health insurance, stock options, flexible work arrangements]. Klook is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire talented and passionate people of all backgrounds. We believe that a joyful workplace is an inclusive workplace, one where employees from all walks of life have an equal opportunity to thrive. We’re dedicated to creating a welcoming and supportive culture where everyone belongs. Klook does not accept unsolicited resumes from any temporary staffing agency, placement service or professional recruiter (“Agency”). Klook will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments related to such unsolicited resumes. An Agency must obtain advance written approval from Klook’s Talent Acquisition Team to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully-executed agreement for service and in response to a specific job opening for which the Agency has been requested to submit resumes for. Klook will not be responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions or other payments to any Agency that does not have such agreement in place or does not comply with the foregoing.

description: Job Description Product Analyst — Payments As a Product Analyst for Payments at J.P. Morgan Personal Investing, you will play a central role in building the metrics and reporting foundation that enables our Product team to make confident, evidence-based decisions. Payments sits at the heart of our platform — supporting all deposit methods, payment integrations, allocation flows, money out, account structures and client money management for our investments platform. There is a real opportunity here to bring structure and clarity to how we measure and understand performance. You will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Operations and Data teams to define what good looks like, measure it consistently, and communicate it clearly. This is a product role — you will bring a product mindset to everything you do, using data as your tool to drive decisions, surface the right problems, and keep initiatives moving forward. You will be supported and coached to grow into broader product responsibilities as your impact and the function develops. Our Product team is at the heart of this venture, focused on getting smart ideas into the hands of our customers. We're looking for people who have a curious mindset, thrive in collaborative squads, and are passionate about building products that make a real difference to our customers' financial lives. By their nature, our teams are solution-oriented, commercially savvy, and have a head for fintech. We work in tribes and squads that focus on specific products and projects — and depending on your strengths and interests, you'll have the opportunity to grow your scope as the function matures Job Responsibilities Establishes and maintains a weekly performance reporting cadence, producing clear and consistent readouts that track indicators, surface trends and flag where attention is needed across Product, Operations and Issue Management Translates complex data into clear, exec-ready narratives — communicating what the data is telling us, what to watch, and where to dig deeper — enabling Product Managers to make well-informed decisions, challenge assumptions and prioritise with confidence Uses performance monitoring and data analysis to proactively identify patterns and signals that inform product health — contributing to a more insight-led approach rather than reacting to issues after the fact Takes ownership of establishing the Payments metrics framework — working in close partnership with the Product Lead to align definitions, taxonomy and data across initiatives and platform areas, creating a foundation the team can trust and act on Works with Engineering to ensure output Proactively drives smaller initiatives and workstreams end-to-end — working directly with engineers from requirements through to delivery, ensuring outcomes are tied back to measurable performance impact Takes ownership of well-scoped work independently, writes clear requirements, and supports testing where needed to maintain delivery pace and quality Works with assumptions where Engineering, Data and Operations — contributing across functions and helping embed a culture of data-informed decision making across the product team Required Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills Typically, 4–7+ years' experience in a relevant product/analytics role Degree in a quantitative/technical discipline (e.g., STEM, Economics, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience, with comfort working with technical partners and data-intensive problems Proven experience in a product analyst, product owner or hybrid product role, with a demonstrable track record of hands-on delivery and ownership Strong SQL skills and practical experience building KPI frameworks, defining metrics and producing reporting that teams use to make decisions — with the curiosity and initiative to go beyond SQL, leveraging AI tools and exploring smarter ways to interrogate and present data Experience working directly with engineering teams and product managers to deliver initiatives end-to-end — comfortable writing requirements, seeing work through to live, and operating effectively in a fast-paced agile environment Ability to translate data into a clear narrative — turning numbers into a story that informs product decisions, not just a dashboard Experience working on customer-facing digital products or platforms Familiarity with product analytics tooling (Amplitude, Looker or equivalent) A self-starter who takes initiative, finds information out independently, and is comfortable working directly with engineers and across product managers Strong communication skills with the ability to present clearly and build exec-ready outputs from complex inputs Intellectually curious, commercially and market aware, and genuinely motivated by solving problems Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities And Skills Experience with end-to-end product analysis — defining problems, structuring analysis and translating findings into clear product recommendations Familiarity description: About Fora Fora is the modern travel agency , empowering anyone with a passion for travel to build a thriving advisory business. We're modernizing the $100B+ travel agency industry by combining powerful technology, data, and community to enable thousands of entrepreneurs to build on our platform. Our business-in-a-box platform gives travel entrepreneurs everything they need to launch and scale, from cutting-edge tools and personalized training to a vibrant community and exclusive industry partnerships. At the heart of it all is our mission: to help the next generation of travel entrepreneurs turn their love for travel into a fulfilling career , whether full-time or part-time. We believe that everyone, from seasoned professionals to first-time advisors, can build something both profitable and personal. Founded in 2021 by seasoned entrepreneurs, Fora has grown steadily since, expanding to a team of 200+ full-time employees based in downtown New York City . In 2026, we announced our $60 million Series D investment round , led by Forerunner and Tactile Ventures, with continued participation from existing investors Thrive Capital, Insight Partners, and Heartcore Capital. We've also been recognized as a LinkedIn Top Startup 2024, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies 2025 and 2023, and we were most recently recognized as one of the TIME100 Most Influential Companies 2026. We're building the first truly unified platform for all travel needs—leveraging the best of human expertise and technology to transform how people plan and book travel. About The Role Fora is looking for a Growth Marketing Manager, Advisor Acquisition to identify, test, and scale new advisor acquisition opportunities that drive long term business growth. This role is focused on finding the channels, strategies, and initiatives that bring in advisors who go on to book meaningful, repeat travel, rather than simply maximizing signups. Reporting to the Performance Marketing Lead, you will own the full lifecycle of growth initiatives, from initial hypothesis through experimentation, measurement, and scaling. You will work closely with Data, Product, Creative, and Site and Conversion partners to develop repeatable frameworks for evaluating new opportunities, making evidence based decisions, and continuously improving acquisition performance. Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, an experimentation mindset, and a passion for using AI as a core part of your day to day workflow to accelerate research, creative iteration, analysis, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities Own the end to end strategy, execution, and optimization of advisor acquisition initiatives across emerging marketing channels and cross functional growth opportunities. Develop, launch, and evaluate structured zero to one experiments with clear hypotheses, success metrics, decision timelines, and predefined criteria for scaling, iterating, or ending initiatives. Build repeatable testing frameworks that enable the team to evaluate new acquisition opportunities consistently and efficiently. Make channel investment decisions based on incrementality, downstream value, and return on ad spend targets, balancing experimentation with disciplined capital allocation. Lead the operating cadence for acquisition performance, including daily pacing reviews, weekly scorecards and growth reviews, and monthly cohort analyses, initiative reviews, and channel deep dives. Partner with the Data team to design measurement approaches that isolate incremental impact and develop robust lifetime value, customer acquisition cost, and cohort quality models. Own the health and optimization of channel measurement signals, ensuring platforms optimize toward meaningful advisor value rather than low quality acquisition metrics. Collaborate with Creative partners to develop, test, and iterate channel specific creative assets, leveraging AI enabled workflows to increase testing velocity and creative learning. Drive landing page and offer experimentation by partnering with Creative and Site and Conversion teams while maintaining ownership of testing strategy, creative alignment, measurement, and recommendations. Build and maintain AI powered automations and agents that streamline recurring workflows such as reporting, competitive research, creative analysis, and performance monitoring. Communicate clear, actionable recommendations based on performance data, providing thoughtful analysis of results and a strong point of view on future investment decisions. Champion an incrementality first approach across all acquisition initiatives by prioritizing rigorous experimental design over traditional attribution models. Requirements Experience owning growth or performance marketing channels and cross functional initiatives from strategy through execution and optimization. Demonstrated success building structured experimentation frameworks that enable scalable decision making rather than isolated campaign testing. Strong understanding of incrementality measurement, including holdout testing, geo experiments, matched market testing, or similar causal methodologies. Deep understanding of lifetime value, customer acquisition cost, return on investment, and downstream business performance as drivers of acquisition strategy. Hands on experience building and deploying AI powered workflows, automations, or agents that improve operational efficiency and remain part of ongoing business processes. Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex performance data into clear recommendations and business decisions. Excellent cross functional collaboration skills with experience partnering closely across marketing, data, creative, product, and technical teams. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast moving environments where experimentation, rapid learning, and continuous iteration are essential. A high degree of ownership, accountability, and bias toward action, with a demonstrated ability to overcome obstacles and drive outcomes independently. A genuine curiosity for learning, continuous improvement, and delivering measurable business impact. Strongly Preferred Experience acquiring partners, affiliates, or marketplace participants in a two sided platform environment. Experience scaling emerging acquisition channels from initial experimentation through sustained investment. Experience working in high growth technology or consumer marketplace businesses. Experience using AI tools to accelerate experimentation, research, reporting, creative development, and workflow automation. Compensation Compensation for this role varies based on experience, with an indicative range of $145k –$175k + equity. Unlimited vacation Health Insurance (including an option completely covered by Fora HQ) Dental & Vision Insurance Wellhub Memberships 401k plan with company match Commuter Benefits Supplemental Life Insurance Stock Options This role is based in our beautiful New York City office (Tribeca/Fidi) with lots of natural light and great views. Our Values We’re forging our own path Fora has always been about driving change within the industry. We’re not interested in maintaining the status quo. We’re stronger together Community is our cornerstone and collective power is our strength. We believe we can all go further when we operate together, using our combined leverage to unlock better opportunities and outcomes for our advisors, partners, and travelers. We believe in technology We believe technology is an answer to some of the most fundamental challenges the travel industry faces. We believe advancements in AI, bold investments in our platforms, and a world-class data infrastructure will transform the work of our advisors and our partners, while creating better travel experiences for travelers. We’re here to serve We operate in service of our community and believe that when they’re empowered to focus on what they do best, we all win. It’s why we relentlessly advocate for our advisors and prioritize their best interest every step of the way. We mean business Fora is equal parts fun, meaningful work and serious travel business. We’re unlocking opportunities for thousands of travel entrepreneurs, delivering a stream of high-quality guests at scale for our partners, and providing a superior travel experience for our travelers. It’s a better equation for the future of our industry. WORK AUTHORIZATION Authorization to work in the United States is required for full-time roles based in our New York City office. Fora is unable to sponsor or assist with U.S. work authorization. Roles based outside of the United States are not subject to this requirement. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY Fora is committed to an equitable hiring process and an inclusive work environment. BIPOC and traditionally underrepresented candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. We will not discriminate and will take action to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, upgrading, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the bases of race, color, gender, national origin, age, religion, creed, disability, veteran's status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression or any other characteristic protected by law.

description: Team: Marketing Prolific At Prolific, our marketplace is rooted in academia, and that commitment runs deep. Alongside our work to accelerate the future of AI, we’re continuing to redefine how the world conducts academic research. What started as a research-driven idea has evolved into the world’s most trusted infrastructure for human data. Today, tens of thousands of researchers from top universities across the globe rely on Prolific to power their work, from peer-reviewed studies to the next generation of technological breakthroughs. We're doubling down on our mission to serve the academic community, deepening relationships, building smarter tools, and making high-quality human data more accessible than ever. The role Prolific for Research is continuing to grow and scale its direct and product-led growth motion (self-serve), and we're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to own the full funnel for our PLG segment, from acquisition through to activation, lifecycle and retention. This role sits at the intersection of full-funnel PLG strategy and hands-on channel execution. You'll be the primary owner of how researchers discover, pilot and stick with Prolific through self-serve channels, and you'll also own paid acquisition strategy on behalf of the wider Prolific for Research marketing team, meaning your work directly supports Industry, Academic and Partnerships campaigns as well as PLG. It's a role for someone who wants genuine end-to-end ownership rather than a single stage of the funnel, and who's comfortable being the connective tissue between all marketing channels, product and lifecycle. What you’ll bring to the role 4–7+ years' experience in Growth or Performance Marketing, with demonstrable ownership of an end-to-end product-led growth (PLG) funnel within a B2B SaaS environment. Proven experience driving measurable improvements across acquisition, activation and retention—not just campaign execution. Strong understanding of paid acquisition across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and other digital channels, with experience shaping strategy and optimising performance. Experience building and optimising onboarding, lifecycle and in-product engagement programmes using tools such as Pendo, Appcues or similar. Strong analytical mindset, with experience measuring funnel performance, defining PQLs, and using platforms such as HubSpot, Metabase or equivalent to inform decisions. Working knowledge of organic growth channels, including SEO, content-led growth and emerging search (AEO), alongside paid acquisition. Confident cross-functional stakeholder manager, able to partner with Product, Sales, RevOps and Customer Success, balance competing priorities and influence decisions. Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with end-to-end ownership. What you’ll be doing in the role Own the end-to-end product-led growth (PLG) strategy for Prolific's self-serve customer journey, driving acquisition, activation, engagement and retention. Develop and optimise onboarding, lifecycle marketing, in-product messaging, referral programmes and customer journeys to improve activation, adoption and long-term retention. Own paid acquisition strategy across search, social and display, working with agency partners and internal teams to optimise performance, budgets and channel effectiveness. Drive organic growth through SEO, content and emerging acquisition channels, continually testing new opportunities to grow the self-serve funnel. Partner closely with Product, Sales, RevOps and Customer Success to define PQLs, optimise handoffs and improve the end-to-end customer experience. Lead a culture of experimentation, using data and insights to continuously optimise funnel performance and measure success across acquisition, activation, conversion and retention. Why Prolific is a great place to work We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems. We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity. Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. Links to more information on Prolific Benefits External Handbook Website Youtube Privacy Statement By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal information.

description: GROWTH MARKETING MANAGER Full-Time Exempt Reports to: Director of Marketing Location: Remote Candidates located in Northern California, the Milwaukee metropolitan area, or the Chicago metropolitan area are strongly preferred. However, exceptional candidates in other locations may be considered based on experience and qualifications. We’re looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager to drive sustainable membership and revenue growth across all club locations. This role is offered by JEM Wellness Brands, the proud franchise operator of Crunch Fitness, the “No Judgment Gym” known for fun, effective workouts. Crunch ranks #1 in fitness and #32 overall on Entrepreneur’s Franchise 500 (2025), with 3M members, 500+ locations, and its new Crunch 3.0 gym design. JEM is growing fast and committed to your future. Since 2022, we are currently at 16 clubs in 4 states (Virginia, Wisconsin, Illinois and California) and set a goal to open 75 new gyms by 2032. Position Overview The Growth Marketing Manager is responsible for driving sustainable membership growth, lead generation, and revenue performance across Limitless Fitness Group's portfolio of open and operating Crunch Fitness locations. This role develops and executes data-driven marketing strategies that support new member acquisition, improve conversion rates, increase member engagement, and drive same-store sales growth. Working closely with the Director of Marketing, operations leadership, club teams, agency partners, and vendors, the Growth Marketing Manager identifies growth opportunities, translates business objectives and club performance data into actionable marketing plans, and ensures effective execution of both digital and local marketing initiatives. This highly collaborative role requires a results-oriented marketer who can successfully balance strategic planning, performance analysis, campaign management, community partnerships, and field-level activation to deliver measurable business outcomes. Growth Marketing Manager Responsibilities Growth Strategy and Performance Ownership Develop and execute marketing strategies that drive membership growth, revenue, leads, joins, and same-store sales across open and operating clubs. Translate company goals and club budgets into actionable market- and club-level growth plans. Evaluate performance by location, market, offer, channel, audience, and campaign to identify risks and opportunities. Build targeted turnaround plans for underperforming clubs and growth plans for clubs with additional market potential. Partner with the Director of Marketing to develop annual, quarterly, and monthly growth plans. Maintain a strong understanding of each club’s goals, membership trends, competitive environment, and operational needs. Campaign Planning and Optimization Lead the execution of promotional campaigns for open and operating locations. Develop campaign briefs, market priorities, messaging recommendations, and club-level activation plans. Ensure digital campaigns are supported by strong local marketing, in-club execution, sales follow-up, and community visibility. Review campaign results and translate findings into clear recommendations for marketing and operations leadership. Identify opportunities to test new channels, audiences, offers, creative concepts, and conversion strategies. Local and Field Marketing Develop scalable local marketing programs that clubs can execute consistently within their communities. Partner with district managers and general managers to create club-specific plans tied to membership and revenue goals. Establish expectations, playbooks, and accountability systems for local outreach, events, grassroots marketing, and community engagement. Provide clubs with the resources, tools, messaging, and training needed to execute approved marketing initiatives. Regularly assess local execution and identify barriers affecting results. Support priority clubs through market visits, community research, competitive analysis, and hands-on activation when appropriate. Corporate Partnerships and Community Growth Identify high-value organizations and partnership opportunities within each club’s trade area. Partner with Corporate Sales Manager to establish a clear process for clubs to generate, qualify, escalate, and manage partnership leads. Create partnership packages, presentations, outreach tools, and activation plans. Develop programs that can be replicated across multiple clubs and markets. Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the primary marketing partner for operations leadership overseeing open and operating clubs. Build strong relationships with district managers, general managers, sales teams, and club leadership. Lead regular performance discussions and provide clear, actionable marketing recommendations. Collaborate with the Senior New Club Marketing Manager to ensure newly opened clubs transition smoothly into the open and operating marketing structure. Partner with the Marketing Coordinator to execute campaigns, develop materials, maintain calendars, and track local initiatives. Communicate marketing priorities, expectations, results, and next steps clearly across departments. Budget and Vendor Management Manage assigned open and operating marketing budgets in partnership with the Director of Marketing. Evaluate the effectiveness of local media, sponsorships, partnerships, events, and other marketing expenditures. Coordinate with agencies and vendors to ensure work is delivered accurately, on time, and within budget. Reporting and Insights Track metrics such as leads, joins, cost per lead, cost per join, conversion rate, membership growth, same-store sales, and return on marketing investment. Identify patterns across markets and translate data into practical actions for the field. Document campaign learnings and incorporate them into future strategies and playbooks. Balance quantitative performance data with operational context, market conditions, and execution quality. Qualifications 5 or more years of experience in growth marketing, field marketing, multi-unit marketing, local store marketing, performance marketing, or a related discipline. Proven success developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable customer acquisition, lead generation, membership growth, and revenue performance. Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, local marketing tactics, conversion optimization, campaign execution, and performance measurement. Experience managing cross-functional initiatives and collaborating effectively with operations teams, vendors, agencies, and business leaders. Demonstrated ability to analyze marketing and business performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively across all levels of the organization. Ability to influence stakeholders, build relationships, and drive accountability without direct authority. Proficiency with marketing analytics, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications. Ability and willingness to travel periodically to clubs, company meetings, events, and priority markets. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting a multi-location consumer, fitness, retail, hospitality, franchise, or membership-based organization. Previous experience in the health, fitness, wellness, or franchise industry. Experience managing local store marketing (LSM) initiatives and community-based marketing programs. Experience working with marketing agencies, creative partners, media vendors, and external service providers. Familiarity with CRM platforms, lead management systems, and customer acquisition funnels. Experience developing market-specific growth plans and supporting new club openings, membership campaigns, or multi-unit business operations. Strong understanding of budget planning, forecasting, and return-on-investment (ROI) analysis. Demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities through data analysis and market insights. Core Competencies Strategic Thinking Performance Analysis Revenue & Growth Orientation Cross-Functional Leadership Field Engagement Accountability Budget Management Project Management Executive Communication Creative Problem-Solving Ownership & Initiative Success in This Role Success will be measured by membership and revenue growth across open and operating clubs, improvement in marketing efficiency, performance against club-level goals, strength of the local marketing and partnership pipeline, consistency of field execution, and the ability to turn marketing insights into measurable business results. Role Boundaries The Growth Marketing Manager owns growth strategy and marketing execution for open and operating locations. New club opening strategy and presale marketing remain under the Senior New Club Marketing Manager. Enterprise marketing strategy, agency leadership, vendor relationships, department direction, and final budget authority remain with the Director of Marketing. Education Requirements Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Communications, Advertising, Marketing, Sales, or a related field preferred. HS Diploma or GED Required. Travel Requirements This is a remote position that requires travel of approximately 25%, based on business needs, marketing initiatives, and organizational priorities. Travel will primarily support club visits, new gym openings, local marketing activations, leadership meetings, market assessments, acquisitions, and growth initiatives across the company portfolio. The Growth Marketing Manager is expected to maintain a strong presence in the field to build partnerships with club leadership, evaluate marketing performance, and support execution of local growth strategies. Candidates must be able and willing to travel as needed, including occasional overnight and multi-day travel. Compensation (Salary) $85,000 - $100,000 per year Performance based annual bonus Benefits Comprehensive Health Coverage – Full-time team members are eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance. Income Protection – Short-term and long-term disability insurance available for full-time employees. Additional Coverage Options – Access to a variety of ancillary insurance plans for full-time employees. Retirement Savings – 401(k) plan with employee contribution options, available to all employees after six months of service available for full-time and part-time employees. Flexible Time Off – Enjoy flexible paid time off (salary employees only). Paid Holidays – Company-designated holidays throughout the year for salaried team members. Wellness Perks – Complimentary Crunch gym membership for all employees. About JEM Wellness Brands Founded in 2022, JEM Wellness Brands is a first-in-class health and wellness franchisee platform and an official franchise partner of Crunch Fitness. Our mission is simple: to empower people to feel good in their bodies, confident in their choices, and connected to a lifestyle of wellness. Through our portfolio of industry-leading brands, we do good by doing well. We envision a world where wellness is accessible, inclusive, and deeply personal—where fitness, beauty, and recovery are not just services, but a way of life. Guided by our core values of Resilience, Service, Transformation, and Excellence , we strive to create meaningful experiences for our community, team members, and customers. At JEM, culture is our heartbeat. We’re a team of passionate leaders and purpose-driven professionals who celebrate wins, support growth, and put people first—always. Demonstrated technical or domain expertise, utilising a depth and breadth of knowledge and practical experience within the specific domain or technical area. Stays up to date with regulatory and other changes in the technical area, and understands how they apply to the Emirates group. Well-versed with the tools for the Product Management aspects of software delivery. Strong and concise communicator at peer, line, and stakeholder levels. Builds strong relationships with peers and team members. Appetite for building and identifying value, with a customer centric mind-set. Leadership Role: Yes Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotels stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.
